metric_scopes.M2: Independent pypdf pages with nonempty text / physical pages; common to versions
metric_scopes.M3_citations: Literal-valid citations / all emitted dossier citations, including activities/annexes; not semantic correctness
metric_scopes.M3_fields: Nonempty InterpretedFields with at least one valid citation / nonempty InterpretedFields
metric_scopes.M4: Nonempty InterpretedFields with at least one citation and all citations valid / nonempty InterpretedFields
metric_scopes.M5_anchors: Mechanically valid native anchors / anchors emitted; no correctness of occurrence or relation inferred
metric_scopes.M5_units: Units with mechanically valid own header anchor / units emitted; does not validate logical session count
metric_scopes.M6: Strong InterpretedFields with missing/invalid evidence / strong InterpretedFields; raw supported OR audit checked
metric_scopes.M7: Documents with any invalid source identity/citation/anchor / included PDFs, accompanied by failures/no-output counts
metric_scopes.W: Normalized text agreement with two blinded AI references on four overview slots per document; unknowns retained; not human accuracy
